road_iou.denominator: road TP+FP+FN over the known area (label != 255)
road_iou.unknown_rule: no prediction or no known area -> UNKNOWN (never 0)
road_iou.note: 道路像素代理；不能证明没有把土肩当道路（那要铺装/土肩单独指标）

line_iou.denominator: line TP+FP+FN over the known area (label != 255)
line_iou.unknown_rule: no predicted line px or no known line px -> UNKNOWN
line_iou.note: 研究结论用；单独改善不能变成模型晋级（见 gates.PRIMARY_ORDER）

line_precision.denominator: predicted line px **inside the known area**
line_precision.note: 未知区里的预测不参与分子分母，但要单独计数上报

line_recall.denominator: reference line px inside the known area
line_recall.note: 只在有效标线参考上统计；**必须报告场景覆盖**（参考缺失的帧不进分母）

offroad_false_ratio.denominator: predicted line px inside the known area (NOT all predicted px)
offroad_false_ratio.note: 实测口径缺陷（G04）：旧实现用全部预测像素当分母，未知区的预测会稀释它

pred_unknown_line_px.unknown_rule: always a count (0 is a real value here)
pred_unknown_line_px.note: 落在未知区的预测像素：不算成功、不算假线，但必须上报

candidate_identity_rate.denominator: candidates that have a usable reference (projection match within the frozen tolerance)
candidate_identity_rate.unknown_rule: no reference for a candidate -> that candidate is UNKNOWN, not a miss
candidate_identity_rate.note: 当前实现是投影候选匹配率；不等于左右车道身份正确，必须与角色一致率分开报

candidate_reference_coverage.denominator: all candidates in the evaluated frames
candidate_reference_coverage.unknown_rule: no candidates at all -> coverage UNKNOWN
candidate_reference_coverage.note: 可测候选覆盖率：覆盖率本身要过门，不能只在容易区域算高匹配率

left_right_role_agreement.denominator: matched candidates with a side label on both sides
left_right_role_agreement.note: 左右角色一致率：与 identity_rate 分开报

inference_ms_p95.unknown_rule: no clean repeat -> UNKNOWN (polluted repeats are recorded, not averaged)
inference_ms_p95.note: 离线分割链（预处理+前向+后处理）；**不能**替代完整驾驶 tick deadline

tick_deadline_miss_ratio.note: 完整驾驶闭环指标，离线实验一律未测

coverage_requirements.what: 左/右边缘、中央线、白/黄线、实/虚线
斜线、断线、交汇、不同远近尺度
阴影、磨损、车辆遮挡、亮度变化
路缘石、排水槽、护栏反光、墙面、轮胎印
能确认整片评价区域无线，保留边界信息
铺装/土肩与纯土路分别标记

statistics.seeds_needed_formula: n = (2*sd/|delta|)^2 (conservative: strict paired t design would use (1.96+0.84)^2=7.84)

aggregation.hard_gate: every seed and every evaluated scene must pass on its own; the cross-seed mean may not rescue a bad seed or scene
aggregation.per_seed: measured per seed; missing counts as UNKNOWN -> needs_evidence
aggregation.per_scene: measured per map/source_id group; a scene with no measurement is UNKNOWN -> needs_evidence

candidate_gates.coverage_denominator: candidates produced on frames that HAVE a line reference; scenes with no line truth are negative scenes judged by the negative-line metric instead

spatial_buffer_note: frozen from the front camera's visible range at 536x403 (~40-60 m of road): a conservative 50 m buffer. Changing the camera or resolution requires recalibration and a new protocol version.

thresholds.source: T13 baselines + plan T14 §5; candidate gates calibrated 2026-09-26 on the 136-frame authoritative human-truth set (docs/CANDIDATE_GATE_CALIBRATION_20260926.md)
